brief:
Israel's new administrative divisions in Gaza seek to fragment the territory and erase Palestinian national identity, according to experts cited by Al Jazeera English. The so-called "Green Rafah" plan establishes separate zones that experts say are designed to prevent Palestinian self-determination and encourage mass displacement from the enclave.

The arrangement would isolate Gaza's population into disconnected areas, undermining prospects for Palestinian statehood and political unity, analysts said. By dividing the territory into distinct administrative units, the plan would sever the geographic and political coherence necessary for a functioning Palestinian state, experts warned. Analysts characterized the zoning scheme as part of a broader strategy to transform Gaza's political and territorial structure while reducing Palestinian claims to unified governance.
dek: Experts warn Israel's new administrative zones in Gaza seek to erase the Palestinian cause and force mass displacement.
title: Israel's Gaza zoning plan aims to fragment territory, experts warn
